exposure: Women who did not undergo CDMR
receiving education or medical information about the possibility of delivering by CS
cohort: Pregnant women planning a cesarean section at King Abdulaziz Medical City in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, between March and June 2017.
finding: The study found a high prevalence of cesarean delivery on maternal request, particularly among older mothers, those with a family history of cesarean section, non-Saudi nationality, and those who received education or information about cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: This study focuses on cesarean delivery on maternal request (CDMR), investigating factors associated with CDMR prevalence and motives.
